Terms of Use

Effective 5 September 2026.

DexLadder is a simulator, not a broker, exchange, wallet or adviser. Every balance, order, fill and position in it is paper. No real money and no real cryptocurrency ever moves, and nothing in the app is financial advice.

1. What the app is

DexLadder is an educational crypto market terminal. It shows real, publicly available market and blockchain data, and lets you practise against that data with simulated funds. Fees, spread, slippage, funding and liquidation are modelled so that the practice is realistic; the money is not.

2. What the app is not

  • It does not execute real trades, and is not connected to any exchange as a trading venue.
  • It does not hold, custody, transfer, buy or sell any asset, and never asks for a private key, seed phrase or wallet connection.
  • It does not provide investment, financial, legal, accounting or tax advice, and nothing in it is a recommendation to buy or sell anything.
  • Simulated results are not a track record and do not predict real outcomes. Real crypto markets are volatile and you can lose everything you put into them.

3. Data accuracy

Prices, on-chain records, headlines and indicators come from public third-party sources. They may be delayed, incomplete, mistaken or unavailable, and the app shows plainly when a feed has not answered rather than inventing a number. You should not rely on anything shown here for a real financial decision.

4. Third-party content and links

Headlines, article summaries, coin logos and reference material belong to their publishers, and open in their own sites when you tap them. We do not endorse third-party content, and we are not responsible for it.

5. Acceptable use

Use the app for learning and practice. Do not attempt to disrupt, reverse-engineer for malicious purposes, or misrepresent simulated results as real trading performance to anyone else.

6. Price

DexLadder is free. There are no in-app purchases, no subscriptions and no advertising.

7. No warranty; limitation of liability

The app is provided "as is", without warranty of any kind, express or implied, including fitness for a particular purpose. To the fullest extent permitted by law, we are not liable for any loss arising from your use of the app or reliance on anything displayed in it.
